hypothesis: Year-over-year single-quarter gross-margin expansion measures improving pricing power and cost efficiency. Unlike the failed gross-margin stability factor, it captures the direction of change rather than the absence of variation, and may add information beyond the R221 SG&A level factor.

factor.formula: current single-quarter gross margin minus the same quarter one year earlier; higher means gross margin expanded
factor.quarterization: Q1 uses reported cumulative values; later quarters subtract the prior cumulative quarter; current and year-ago quarters require revenue > 0 and non-null operating costs
factor.window: current quarter versus same quarter four fiscal quarters earlier
factor.effective_date: current quarter statutory disclosure deadline plus four calendar days
factor.point_in_time: statutory-deadline fallback; local 2021Q1-2026Q2 financial snapshots; no 2018-2020 restated data used
factor.missing_policy: no filling, no zero substitution, no fallback to SG&A level, SG&A stability or gross-margin stability factors

universe.rule: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}
universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, gross-margin-trend availability filter and execution; trend is not a score component.

related_benchmarks.use: D3 correlation and G9 full-sample relative-performance gate

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation is at most 0.70 against both the R221 SG&A level factor and the R223 gross-margin stability factor
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The factor definition, non-financial universe, scoring weights, holding period and stop loss are frozen before factor construction. No post-result relaxation, filling, industry redefinition, or substitution with prior factors is allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
Financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
Gross-margin expansion can reflect accounting classification changes or one-off cost shocks rather than durable pricing power.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
